name: What is the process for implementing AI SEO for a small business?
description: The process involves AI-driven audits, keyword research, content optimization, technical SEO improvements, and continuous performance monitoring.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for implementing AI SEO for a small business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Implementing AI SEO typically begins with an initial audit using AI tools to identify current performance gaps and opportunities. This is followed by AI-powered keyword research to find high-value terms and content gap analysis. Next, AI assists in optimizing existing content or generating new, SEO-friendly content. Technical SEO improvements are identified and implemented, and continuous monitoring and refinement are conducted using AI to track performance, analyze competitor moves, and adapt strategies for ongoing improvement.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves AI-driven audits, keyword research, content optimization, technical SEO improvements, and continuous performance monitoring.
